The task was to find the latest NBA trade or player movement on ESPN and report the most recent trade deal or player acquisition.

The result response reports: Sacramento Kings signed guard Sean Pedulla to a two-way contract on October 23, 2026. The screenshot shows ESPN’s Sacramento Kings Transactions 2026 page, with the October section listing: “October 23, 2026 — Signed G Sean Pedulla to a two-way contract.” This directly supports the reported player acquisition.

Although the screenshot only shows the Kings team transactions page and not the full ESPN league-wide transactions list, the response states that ESPN’s league-wide NBA transactions page listed this as the newest dated item. Since this is not contradicted by the screenshot, it is acceptable.

Verdict: SUCCESS
